content: Official Three.js documentation recommends glTF/GLB for compact runtime delivery, exposes GLTFLoader as an addon, and provides LineLoop and BufferGeometry.setFromPoints for lightweight closed guide rendering. WebGLRenderer supports low-power hints and reports render/memory statistics. Keep the existing dynamically loaded Three.js/GLTFLoader viewer and build guides from provider-authored levels/contours with explicit disposal; do not add a second 3D engine.
